# Support Guidelines

## Financials
- **Goodwill Credits:** Capped at $15 per case. Do not exceed this even if the customer requests more.
- **Refunds:** 
  - Any refund above $40 must be escalated to `finance-ops` using `desk.py escalate <case> finance-ops`.
  - Do NOT run the `refund` action directly for amounts over $40.

## Communication
- **Sign-off:** All replies must end exactly as follows:
  Warmly,
  The Marlowe & Pine Crew

## Case Management
- **Tagging:** Every case must have exactly one category tag before closing.
- **Allowed Tags:** `billing`, `shipping`, `product`, `account`, or `other`.
- **Warning:** No other labels, no multiple tags, and no empty tags are permitted.

# Company Guidelines & Policies

## Credits & Compensation
- **Goodwill Credit Cap:** Maximum $15 per case, regardless of the customer's request.

## Communication Standards
- **Multilingual Greetings:** For customers with non-English locales, start the reply with a greeting in their local language (e.g., "Olá" for pt-BR, "Hola" for es-ES) as the first line.
- **Delivery Dates:** Never promise a specific delivery date or number of days. Instead, provide the tracking number and state that the carrier has the most up-to-date information.
- **Standard Sign-off:** Every email must end exactly as follows:
  Warmly,
  The Marlowe & Pine Crew

## Ticket Management
- **Tagging:** Every case must have exactly one category tag before closing. 
- **Allowed Tags:** `billing`, `shipping`, `product`, `account`, `other`.
- **Constraint:** No more than one tag, no fewer than one tag. Any other labels will break reporting.

# Support Guidelines & SOPs

## Financials & Refunds
- Refunds > $40: Do NOT process directly. Escalate to `finance-ops` using `desk.py escalate <case> finance-ops`. (Old process: billing-review).

## Account Security
- Email Changes: Must perform identity check first. Run `desk.py verify <case> <customer> <order>` and wait for confirmation before using `set-email`.

## Communications
- Standard Sign-off (Mandatory):
  Warmly,
  The Marlowe & Pine Crew

## Case Management
- Tagging: Every case MUST have exactly one category tag before closing.
- Allowed Tags: [billing, shipping, product, account, other].
- Constraint: No more, no less. Invalid tags or missing/multiple tags break reporting.
